messages:
Rina: Heads up — microwave smelled like fish after lunch. Can whoever reheated please label next time? :fish: :nose:
Oscar: that was me, sorry! I forgot the lid. won't happen again.
kitchen-bot: Alert: MICROWAVE_DEODOR required. Suggested action: wipe interior + leave door ajar for 15m.
Sam: Also low on coffee filters and single-serve sugar packets. Who's on snack run this week?
Tasha: I can do a run tomorrow morning — what to get? Filters, oatmilk, plain granola bars.
Ben: add iced tea pouches and decaf please. No hazelnut syrup (allergy).
Luca: Suggestion: small sticker labels with initials + date. I can tape a roll to the dispenser.
Rina: love stickers. Can we put a 'Fridge Zone' map on the door? Lunchboxes in middle shelf only.
Oscar: +1 for map. Also pizza poll for Friday demo: react :one: cheese, :two: pepperoni, :three: veg/vegan
Sam: :three:
Tasha: :two:
Ben: :one:
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: Snack run (filters/oatmilk/granola) tomorrow 09:00. Fridge cleanout in 5 days.
Rina: thanks all — Luca, stickers and I will print the fridge map tonight. Please label your food by EOD tomorrow. :label:
